facts.material: natural stone (Saturnia), charcoal gray to black mottled, geological type not stated
facts.function: raw slabs to be cut for countertops, bathroom and furniture surfaces
facts.form: large slabs 115-122 x 65-75 in, 0.75 or 1.5 in thick, top polished, sides sawn
facts.end_use: kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, office furniture surfaces

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 6802 worked monumental or building stone; polished top is worked beyond simply cut; chapter 25 slabs only merely cut are excluded
GRI 6: 6802.99 other stone (assumed not granite) over 6802.93 granite

rejected_alternatives.reason: top is polished, more than merely cut; heading 2515 covers only merely cut stone
applies only if stone is granite (as in N354811 Caravelas); Saturnia lab type not given; most sibling Brazilian slab rulings were other stone
marble/limestone line; stone is not described as calcareous

missing_facts: geological identity of Saturnia (granite vs other igneous vs calcareous) - lab result not stated
classification.rationale: Polished slab for countertops is worked building stone of heading 6802 (not 2515, merely cut). If granite it would fall in 6802.93 (N354811); sibling rulings on same-dimension slabs (N353775 White Spring, other igneous) went to 6802.99.0090. Assuming non-granite other stone, 6802.99.00.90.
